_doc_models: LLM calls route through Podbit via the `podbit` block above. The `models` block is a fallback only — uncomment and fill in if running standalone without Podbit.

specTypes.nn_training_profile: Train a single neural network configuration and collect measurements (loss curve, accuracy, gradient stats, weight norms, sparsity distribution). DATASET RULE: Default to synthetic_quadratic or synthetic_regression. Use MNIST only if real classification data is needed. CIFAR-10 is ONLY for claims that explicitly require colour/multi-channel images.
specTypes.nn_paired_comparison: Train 2+ configurations with matched seeds and compute cross-condition measurements (convergence speed ratio, accuracy difference, sparsity divergence, gradient divergence). Use when comparing configurations. DATASET RULE: Prefer synthetic datasets — most comparison claims (optimizer behaviour, architecture differences, hyperparameter sensitivity) are testable on synthetic_quadratic/synthetic_regression without real data.
specTypes.nn_sparsity_profile: Train with a sparsity method and measure per-layer sparsity distribution, accuracy impact, and gradient stats. DATASET RULE: Use MNIST or Fashion-MNIST — sparsity effects are observable on small datasets. Avoid CIFAR-10 unless the claim specifically requires multi-channel convolutions.
specTypes.nn_optimizer_dynamics: Train on a synthetic loss surface and collect optimizer-specific measurements: effective LR trajectories, gradient stats, Hessian top eigenvalue. Use for optimizer behaviour, LR adaptation, loss landscape geometry — NOT task performance. ALWAYS use synthetic_quadratic or synthetic_regression.
specTypes.nn_architecture_scaling: Train configurations varying in depth/width, measuring how accuracy, convergence, gradient stats, weight norms change with scale. DATASET RULE: Use MNIST or synthetic datasets. Scaling behaviour is observable without large datasets.
specTypes.nn_codegen: Generate custom PyTorch training code via LLM for experiments beyond fixed menus — custom architectures, activations, loss functions, optimizers, training procedures, novel measurements. DATASET RULE: Always use the smallest dataset that answers the question. Default to synthetic_quadratic/synthetic_regression. MNIST only when real data is needed. CIFAR-10 is a last resort for claims that explicitly demand colour images.
